Role Description:
The Senior Manager, SEC Reporting & Technical Accounting reports to the Head of
Accounting and will work within the Corporate Accounting department, which is
responsible for the Company’s external and internal financial reporting, consolidated
financial close and technical accounting projects.
In this position, you’ll play a critical
role in ensuring the accuracy, compliance, and quality of our financial reporting.
Your
expertise in technical accounting and deep understanding of SEC regulations will be
instrumental in guiding our organization through complex financial matters and
ensuring adherence to reporting standards on the public readiness journey.
As the
Senior Manager, SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting you will facilitate our financial
reporting process and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) process, tackling complex technical
accounting matters.
This is an interesting position due to the varying duties for which this person is
responsible and provides an opportunity to see the operating results of the entire multi-
national corporation and interact with finance teams around the world.
The ideal
candidate is a detail-oriented, self-motivated leader with a very strong working
knowledge of U.S.
GAAP and SEC regulations.
Responsibilities:

Create and implement external reporting structure and function.Manage preparation and review of the Company’s SEC reporting, including forms 10-K, 10-Q and other company filings meeting Company, SEC, and other regulatory requirements within the required deadlines.Review of iXBRL tagging of financial statements and footnotes.Act as the subject matter expert on US GAAP and SEC regulations for preparing and filing SEC reports; demonstrate a clear understanding of related authoritative literature governing financial reporting for public companies.Stay current on new/proposed accounting guidance and best practices, including GAAP and SEC Reporting.Analyze, assess, and document the impact of relevant technical guidance on the Company’s operations reporting including accounting policies and disclosures, and provide guidance on how to implement required modifications.Update and create technical memos for the Company and partner with the Head of Accounting, Corporate Controller and Business leaders to implement new guidance.Manage external GAAP reporting to be used by the CEO, COO, CFO and Investor Relations, including earnings releases (and potentially investor presentations).
suggestions: SEC reporting; external reporting structure and function; iXBRL tagging of financial statements and footnotes; US GAAP and SEC regulations; new/proposed accounting guidance; best practices; GAAP and SEC Reporting; accounting policies and disclosures; relevant technical guidance
